data.name: Odele
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'odele', meaning 'wealthy one'. In Greek mythology, Odele was the name of a nymph who protected the forests and mountains. In Christianity, Odele represents the spiritual wealth gained through faith and devotion.

Odele serves as an inspiration for those seeking to enrich their spirituals lives with faith, love, and inner peace.
